howToApply: Each row is one `node scripts/figma/add-state-board.mjs <cloneFrom.id> "<newBoardName>" --wire-from <wireFrom.id> --apply`. The clone inherits the source board's panel chrome (tab row, filter chips, approval band, prune note) rather than a second hand-drawn copy of it. THEN resolve the clone's own TEXT ids and write `copy` onto it with history-resolve-ids.mjs + apply-text-fixes.mjs; the copy plan cannot be authored before the clones have ids.
markerPolicy: A state the code can already produce ships unmarked; a state the code cannot yet produce ships '[design-ahead]', which is this section's own convention (the seven Backups boards). The marker is in the name at CREATION rather than added by a later apply-truth-marks pass, so a board cannot exist for even one run without the claim it makes about the code attached to it.

boards.why: 'Clear' wipes the entire undo stack (HistoryManager.ts:783-799 empties BOTH stacks). The confirm is the same button re-labelled 'Clear all' with a Cancel beside it (ActivityView.tsx:471-490) and never states the consequence. copy.title: Clear this session's history?

notes: The finding's alternative is 'or drop the control — nothing about a session's undo stack needs manual clearing, and the button's only reachable outcome is data loss.' Recorded as an open decision on this board rather than taken: deleting a control is a founder call, and the costed confirm is safe either way.

boards.why: Some features deliberately change the project outside history and disable Undo until the next recorded action (HistoryManager.ts:639-646 noteUnrecordedAction -> EVENTS.HISTORY_UNRECORDED; callers BaseBindingManager.ts:106,125,134 and MediaCommandLayer.ts:108). copy.notice: Undo isn't covering your last action
copy.body: Binding a field to content isn't undoable. Undo starts working again with your next edit.
copy.undoTooltip: Undo unavailable — binding a field to content isn't recorded in history

notes: PARTIALLY STALE FINDING. UX-I-15 says 'nothing in the UI listens'. That stopped being true on 2026-09-04: useComposerInit.ts:705-716 includes EVENTS.HISTORY_UNRECORDED in HISTORY_STATE_EVENTS and re-reads canUndo/canRedo on it, so the Undo CONTROL is already disabled (commit de36af334 'fix(history): Undo stops offering after an action that is not in history'). What is still missing — and what this board draws — is NAMING the action. The switch-off is no longer silent, only anonymous.

The label is engine-supplied user-facing copy: noteUnrecordedAction's `label` argument is 'said the way the toast will say it' per its own docblock, and BaseBindingManager.ts:106 passes 'binding a field to content'.
